what: The rft rung's validity lines against MIME's MRS rung on the same body (#175: measured, never quoted). Written before the run that records them; the record (record.json) holds the measured misses, and each line is set from it by the rule below, never by a tolerance chosen after the numbers were seen.
rule: A line is the largest miss measured over the points it claims, rounded up to two significant figures; it holds only over those points (their range in each axis named), and a body outside them is flagged as unmeasured, never claimed. A point whose rft resistance is indefinite (refused by the rung) is reported as refused and claims no line.

outputs.speed: the force-free swimming speed along the body's axis, U / Omega = -R[0,3] / R[0,0] about the helix's axis's middle; the miss |rft / mrs - 1|
outputs.resistance: the 6 x 6 about the body's centre of mass, each row and column scaled by the square root of the MRS's diagonal; the miss the largest entry of the scaled difference (rft - mrs)

reference: Drag.MRS on the same kind: spacing 0.79 filament radii (8 force points round the filament), blob 0.25 of the spacing, quadrature_refinement 8 (the screw family's blob and its rule's refinement); its own resolution measured at the first point by spacings 1.05, 0.79 and 0.52 filament radii and blobs 0.1 to 0.5.
rft: Drag.RFT at its defaults (spacing one point a filament radius; Lighthill's coefficients on a helix, the slender spheroid's on a straight centreline).
exact_reference: A prolate spheroid's exact resistance (Kim & Karrila's closed form, dev1's tests/mrs_cases.py::prolate), in place of the MRS: the same outputs and misses.
